context: Tests whether the agent maps the Ruby manifest to the ruby language parameter, prefers Gemfile.lock pinned versions over Gemfile ranges, and invokes the Meterian CLI. CLI invocation verified via scan-raw.json Meterian format.

checklist.name: ruby language
checklist.description: `scan-raw.json` contains entries with `"language":"ruby"` — confirming the correct language parameter (not `gem`, `rubygems`, or `rails`)

checklist.name: Gemfile.lock preferred
checklist.description: Extracts dependency versions from `Gemfile.lock` rather than the version ranges in `Gemfile`

checklist.name: Pinned versions used
checklist.description: The versions in `scan-raw.json` match the pinned versions in Gemfile.lock (e.g. rails 5.2.3, nokogiri 1.9.1) rather than Gemfile ranges

checklist.name: Raw scan data file
checklist.description: A file named `scan-raw.json` exists containing a JSON object with a `vulnerable` array — the Meterian CLI check output format

checklist.name: Markdown table
checklist.description: Report contains a markdown table with audit result columns (Package, Version, Severity, ID, Safe Version(s))

checklist.name: Summary line
checklist.description: Report includes a summary line with vulnerability and package counts
